notes: UPDATE after the network opened at about 14:07 UTC: elections.bexar.gov became reachable through the fetch module. The county elections home page links 'Election Night Returns' to https://results.enr.clarityelections.com/TX/Bexar/127291/, so the election-night platform is Clarity ENR (clarity_style); this confirms the earlier search-summary lead. The Historical page (elections.bexar.gov/35/Historical) archives county PDFs and CSVs: for Nov 5 2024 'Official Precinct Report (PDF)' and '(CSV)', 'Official Summary Report', 'Unofficial Reconciliation Report' and a CVR zip; for Mar 3 2026 'Democratic - Official Precinct Report', 'Republican - Official Precinct Report' and 'March 3, 2026 Primary Results'; for May 26 2026 'Joint Primary Runoff Election-Precinct Official Results Report'. All archived precinct reports are labeled Official (post-canvass). Clarity ENR sites can carry precinct-level detail, but nothing fetched shows whether precinct-level data was on the Clarity site during election night for the three target elections, so the tag stays UNKNOWN. Contact from the county elections home page: 'Phone: 210-335-VOTE (8683)', fax 210-335-0850, mailto bexarcountyelections@bexar.gov, 1103 S. Frio; the TX SOS list gives Elections Administrator Michele Carew, (210) 335-8683, County Email Address mailto BexarCountyElections@bexar.org. Earlier (pre-14:07 UTC) attempts: fetch module to elections.bexar.gov and elections.bexar.org/1840/Contact-Us failed (robots_disallowed_or_unreachable, proxy 403); Wayback probe for home.bexar.org/el45a.html failed for all windows; WebFetch to sanantonioreport.org was EGRESS_BLOCKED. Stated change: a San Antonio Report article (sanantonioreport.org/bexar-county-election-modernization-2026-midterm-election/) was summarized as saying the county 'overhauled its website to deliver results'; not shown to concern precinct-level reporting, so stated_change_2026 is n. Usage notice: Clarity pages are JavaScript apps and no notice text was fetched; left empty.
tag_rationale: Bexar uses Clarity ENR on election night and archives only official (post-canvass) precinct reports; no source shows when precinct-level results appeared on election night.
